hero.headline: AI-Powered Websites Under Your Brand — Launched in Minutes, Not Months

Hostopia's Online Presence Builder removes that friction entirely — customers describe their business, and AI generates a professional, mobile-ready site with copy, imagery, and layout ready to publish under your brand.

features.heading: Everything Your SMBs Need — Under Your Brand
features.intro: OPB runs fully white-label: your logo, your URL, your customer portal. Hostopia is invisible — from first login through every publish, upgrade, and support ticket.

cards.title: AI Site Generation
cards.body: Customers input their business details. OPB produces a complete, multi-page website with copy, imagery, layout, maps, and contact forms in under five minutes.

cards.title: Drag-and-Drop Editor
cards.body: Responsive themes, vertical-specific templates, and pre-built content blocks for hero sections, galleries, FAQs, testimonials, and contact pages — all editable without code.

cards.title: Built-In Conversion Tools
cards.body: Lead capture forms, Google Maps, social widgets, and clear CTAs come standard. One-click Online Store activation opens the door to ecommerce expansion.

cards.title: Integrated Hosting & Platform
cards.body: Reliable, scalable hosting included by default. Unlimited pages, per-page SEO settings, and Google Analytics, all managed through your branded dashboard.

cards.title: Industry Template Library
cards.body: Hundreds of pre-built layouts across professional services, retail, trades, food, medical, and more — so SMBs launch with a design that fits their category.

cards.title: White-Label Everything
cards.body: Your brand, your pricing, your commercial model, your support path. Customers never see Hostopia — they see the platform you sell.

partnerAdvantage.heading: Built for Service Providers. Not Bolted On.
partnerAdvantage.intro: OPB turns website services from a support-heavy cost center into a scalable, AI-driven revenue engine — with activation rates that outperform every DIY tool on the market.

items.title: Activate more of your base
items.body: AI-driven onboarding means customers who previously abandoned DIY tools now actually finish and publish. Higher activation rates translate directly to more paying subscribers and fewer stalled accounts.

items.title: Grow revenue per customer
items.body: Websites are the entry point. Once customers are live on OPB, the path to ecommerce, SEO, directory listings, and email marketing is a natural conversation — not a cold pitch.

items.title: Reduce operational drag
items.body: No web development team required. No infrastructure to maintain. AI handles site creation for your customers, and automated provisioning handles delivery for your ops team.

items.title: Differentiate from commodity providers
items.body: An AI-powered, branded website platform integrated into your existing services and billing sets you apart from standalone builders and low-cost hosting commodities.

lifecycleFit.heading: The Foundation of Your Digital Services Portfolio
lifecycleFit.intro: OPB sits at the center of your "Get Online" motion — the entry point that pulls the rest of your digital portfolio through with it.

steps.title: Build a Brand
steps.body: Domains, logo design, and professional email establish the SMB's identity before the site goes live.

steps.title: Get Online
steps.body: AI-powered websites and hosting launch in minutes under your brand — turning new customers into active, published businesses.

steps.title: Get Found
steps.body: SEO, directory listings, and reputation management drive visibility and trust once the site is live.

steps.title: Grow
steps.body: Ecommerce, email marketing, and custom development scale the business on top of the same platform.

lifecycleFit.positioning: Position OPB as the default website offering for new connectivity customers, the modern upgrade path for hosting-only accounts, and the foundation for ecommerce and digital marketing expansion.
